name: TC-866: @scenario S4 Any 2 medium pizzas for $19.99 — two 'Any item from <category>' lines; paid toppings show as upgrades
description: Build: Combo price → search the per-run pizza category and pick 'Any item from' it, twice (each line reads 'Customer picks 1 from <category> · 2 items'), $19.99, Save and turn on.
